events.text: # Day 2 Authoritative Collection, Re-Emission, and Closeout

## Final authoritative carry-forward set
- controller_contract.yaml
- phase_contract.yaml
- artifact_contract.yaml
- artifact_taxonomy.md
- foil_promotion_contract.yaml
- round_robin_notes_template.yaml
- creative_ust_canonical_shell.md
## Re-emitted artifacts

### controller_contract.yaml

```yaml
meta:
  artifact_name: controller_contract.yaml
  artifact_type: governing_contract
  version: v5_c.day2_authoritative
  status: authoritative_done
  mode: exact_canon
  purpose: define the controller's exact authority, obligations, prohibitions, and phase-gating duties without widening canon

source_hierarchy:
  order:
    - canonical_workspace_artifacts
    - session_snapshots_and_migration_notes
    - dev_logs
  governing_rule: lower-order sources may refine implementation detail only when strictly consistent with higher-order sources
  override_rule: no lower-order source may override frozen canon

frozen_canonical_laws:
  - Technical UST is the sole canonical source-of-truth middleware.
  - Creative UST is a derivative downstream shell.
  - Show Summary is a derivative style surface.
  - The assistant acts as a non-creative container-controller.
  - SMEs own musical and creative content decisions.
  - Nulls are signal and may not be silently filled.
  - Sequential zero-skip axis completion is required before deliberation.
  - Round-robin argumentative review is mandatory and produces first-class artifacts.
  - Definitive technical.ust must exist before reverse compilation.
  - Promotion and deduplication follow FOIL discipline and must be ledgered.
  - Frozen surface artifacts precede final Suno prompt packaging.

controller_identity:
  role_name: non_creative_container_controller
  canonical_content_authority: none
  canonical_source_of_truth: technical.ust
  derivative_outputs:
    - creative_ust.txt
    - show_summary.txt
  packaging_outputs:
    - suno_lyrics_prompt
    - suno_style_prompt

controller_scope:
  may:
    - route
    - validate
    - log
    - gate
    - freeze
    - promote
    - package
  no_additional_permission_may_be_inferred: true
  routing_scope:
    allowed:
      - phase progression within frozen phase order
      - artifact progression within frozen artifact ontology
      - validation outcomes
      - freeze transitions
      - FOIL-governed promotion routing
      - packaging initiation after surface freeze
    forbidden:
      - artistic authorship
      - musical decision ownership
      - creative null resolution
      - invention of new authority structures
      - widening of address or routing grammar beyond frozen controller scope

authority_boundaries:
  controller_shall_not_claim:
    - musical_content_ownership
    - creative_content_ownership
    - artistic_authorship
    - SME-substitution authority
    - discretionary authority to merge distinct semantics for convenience
    - standing authority beyond route_validate_log_gate_freeze_promote_package
  smes_own:
    - musical_content_decisions
    - creative_content_decisions
    - content_judgment
    - substantive_resolution_of_unresolved_artistic_or_musical_questions
  controller_override_forbidden: true

operational_invariants:
  - technical.ust is the only canonical source-of-truth artifact.
  - Creative UST and Show Summary are derivative and non-canonical.
  - Nulls remain explicit until resolved by the proper authority; they are never silently filled.
  - No phase may be entered out of order.
  - No downstream progression may bypass zero-skip completion requirements.
  - Round-robin deliberation is mandatory and may not be omitted, compressed, or replaced by summary.
  - Definitive technical.ust lock is required before reverse compilation.
  - Promotion and deduplication actions must follow FOIL discipline and must be ledgered.
  - Surface freeze must occur before final Suno prompt packaging.
  - Derivative artifacts, artifact states, and packaging outputs remain separate classes and may not be collapsed.

controller_obligations:
  general:
    - preserve exact canon without renaming, compression, or semantic widening
    - enforce exact frozen phase order
    - enforce exact frozen freeze taxonomy
    - preserve SME authority boundaries
    - detect omission, truncation, skip, and false completion
    - block downstream progression when any gate condition fails
    - log validation, gating, freeze, promotion, deduplication, and packaging events
    - preserve ontology distinctions between derivative artifacts, artifact states, and packaging outputs
  per_phase:
    sequential_axis_completion:
      must:
        - verify all required axes are completed sequentially
        - reject incomplete or skipped axis sets
    draft_technical_ust_freeze:
      must:
        - freeze draft.technical.ust without relabeling
        - preserve nulls and open items as signal
    round_robin_deliberation:
      must:
        - run mandatory argumentative review
        - preserve round-robin notes as first-class artifacts
        - preserve contradiction logs and governance review artifacts
    definitive_technical_ust_lock:
      must:
        - lock technical.ust as definitive
        - block reverse compilation before lock
    reverse_promotion_deduplication:
      must:
        - apply FOIL discipline
        - ledger all promotion and deduplication actions
        - preserve distinct semantics
      forbidden:
        - convenience merges
        - unledgered deduplication
    concurrent_derivative_surface_drafting:
      must:
        - derive only from definitive technical.ust
        - treat creative_ust.txt as downstream shell output
        - treat show_summary.txt as downstream style-surface output
    surface_freeze:
      must:
        - freeze creative_ust.txt
        - freeze show_summary.txt
        - preserve distinction between derivative drafts and frozen surfaces
    packaging:
      must:
        - package only after surface freeze
        - preserve distinction between surface artifacts and packaging outputs

controller_prohibitions:
  - invent_artistic_content
  - fill_unresolved_nulls_creatively
  - summarize_incomplete_axes_as_complete
  - override_SME_authority
  - compress_before_definitive_technical_consensus
  - merge_distinct_semantics_for_convenience
  - invent_councils_role_taxonomies_or_authority_claims_not_frozen
  - widen_routing_scope_beyond_frozen_controller_scope
  - collapse_derivative_artifacts_into_packaging_outputs
  - collapse_artifact_states_into_artifact_classes
  - collapse_freeze_states_into_one_another
  - treat_dev_logs_as_replacements_for_canon

freeze_taxonomy:
  draft_freeze:
    artifact: draft.technical.ust
    distinct_from:
      - definitive_lock
      - surface_freeze
  definitive_lock:
    artifact: technical.ust
    distinct_from:
      - draft_freeze
      - surface_freeze
  surface_freeze:
    artifacts:
      - creative_ust.txt
      - show_summary.txt
    distinct_from:
      - draft_freeze
      - definitive_lock

artifact_ontology_guard:
  canonical_artifacts:
    - template.technical.ust
    - draft.technical.ust
    - technical.ust
  review_artifacts:
    - round-robin_notes
    - contradiction_logs
    - governance_review_artifacts
  derivative_surface_artifacts:
    - draft.creative.ust
    - draft.show.summary
    - creative_ust.txt
    - show_summary.txt
  packaging_outputs:
    - suno_lyrics_prompt
    - suno_style_prompt
  distinction_rules:
    - do_not_treat_artifact_states_as_artifact_classes
    - do_not_collapse_derivative_artifacts_into_packaging_outputs
    - do_not_collapse_freeze_states

compliance_test:
  controller_contract_is_compliant_only_if:
    - technical.ust remains canonical
    - SME authority remains intact
    - nulls remain explicit
    - sequential zero-skip completion is enforced
    - round-robin review is mandatory and preserved
    - definitive lock precedes reverse promotion and deduplication
    - surface freeze precedes packaging
    - FOIL events are ledgered

```

### phase_contract.yaml

```yaml
meta:
  artifact_name: phase_contract.yaml
  artifact_type: governing_contract
  version: v5_c.day2_authoritative
  status: authoritative_done
  mode: exact_canon
  purpose: define exact per-phase procedure, entry conditions, exit conditions, block conditions, emitted artifacts, and progression rules

governing_parent:
  controller_contract.yaml: governs controller authority and generic enforcement boundaries

frozen_phase_order:
  - sequential axis completion
  - draft.technical.ust freeze
  - round-robin deliberation
  - definitive technical.ust lock
  - reverse promotion / deduplication
  - concurrent derivative surface drafting
  - surface freeze
  - packaging

frozen_freeze_taxonomy:
  draft_freeze:
    artifact: draft.technical.ust
  definitive_lock:
    artifact: technical.ust
  surface_freeze:
    artifacts:
      - creative_ust.txt
      - show_summary.txt

phases:
  sequential_axis_completion:
    entry_conditions:
      - template.technical.ust instantiated
    required_work:
      - fill required axis leaves sequentially without skip
      - preserve unresolved nulls explicitly
      - route substantive content decisions to lawful SMEs
    emitted_artifacts:
      - working technical.ust state
    exit_conditions:
      - all required leaves dispositioned as filled or deliberate null
      - no axis skipped
    block_conditions:
      - skipped axis
      - silent null fill
      - false completeness

  draft_technical_ust_freeze:
    entry_conditions:
      - sequential_axis_completion complete
    required_work:
      - freeze draft.technical.ust without relabeling
      - preserve nulls and open items as signal
    emitted_artifacts:
      - draft.technical.ust
    exit_conditions:
      - draft freeze applied
    block_conditions:
      - unresolved false-completion claim
      - freeze-state confusion

  round_robin_deliberation:
    entry_conditions:
      - draft.technical.ust frozen
    required_work:
      - perform mandatory argumentative review
      - capture contradictions, null handling, and challenge responses
      - preserve notation candidates, promotion candidates, and retained local unique detail as distinct review categories
    emitted_artifacts:
      - round_robin_notes
      - contradiction_logs
      - governance_review_artifacts
    exit_conditions:
      - review completed
      - contradictions dispositioned or explicitly carried forward
    block_conditions:
      - review skipped
      - review compressed into summary

  definitive_technical_ust_lock:
    entry_conditions:
      - round-robin deliberation complete
    required_work:
      - integrate accepted refinements into technical.ust
      - lock technical.ust as definitive
    emitted_artifacts:
      - technical.ust
    exit_conditions:
      - definitive lock applied
    block_conditions:
      - unresolved blocking contradiction
      - reverse compilation attempted before lock

  reverse_promotion_deduplication:
    entry_conditions:
      - technical.ust definitively locked
    required_work:
      - classify repeated material before downstream compression decisions
      - keep notation candidates, promotion candidates, and retained local unique detail procedurally distinct
      - apply FOIL only to promotion and deduplication behavior
      - preserve worker-owned reverse processing by reference
    emitted_artifacts:
      - FOIL promotion ledger entries
      - FOIL deduplication ledger entries
      - repetition classification dispositions
    exit_conditions:
      - repeated material dispositioned
      - FOIL actions ledgered
    block_conditions:
      - repetition remains unclassified
      - promotion treated as repeat notation
      - FOIL absorbs repeat notation
      - character reduction treated as sufficient success

  concurrent_derivative_surface_drafting:
    entry_conditions:
      - reverse_promotion_deduplication complete
    required_work:
      - draft derivative surfaces from definitive technical.ust only
      - treat Creative UST as downstream shell
      - treat Show Summary as downstream style surface
    emitted_artifacts:
      - draft.creative.ust
      - draft.show.summary
    exit_conditions:
      - both derivative drafts exist
    block_conditions:
      - derivative drafted from non-definitive source
      - canonical/derivative confusion

  surface_freeze:
    entry_conditions:
      - draft.creative.ust exists
      - draft.show.summary exists
    required_work:
      - freeze creative_ust.txt
      - freeze show_summary.txt
    emitted_artifacts:
      - creative_ust.txt
      - show_summary.txt
    exit_conditions:
      - surface freeze applied
    block_conditions:
      - frozen surface attempted without draft
      - surface/artifact-state confusion

  packaging:
    entry_conditions:
      - creative_ust.txt frozen
      - show_summary.txt frozen
    required_work:
      - package Suno lyrics prompt from creative_ust.txt
      - package Suno style prompt from show_summary.txt
    emitted_artifacts:
      - suno_lyrics_prompt
      - suno_style_prompt
    exit_conditions:
      - packaging complete
    block_conditions:
      - packaging attempted before surface freeze

progression_rules:
  - no phase may be skipped
  - no downstream phase may begin while an upstream block condition remains active
  - exact frozen phase order is mandatory
  - exact frozen freeze taxonomy is mandatory
  - detailed per-phase procedure lives here, not in controller_contract.yaml

compliance_test:
  phase_contract_is_compliant_only_if:
    - exact 8-phase order is preserved
    - exact freeze taxonomy is preserved
    - each phase defines entry conditions, exit conditions, block conditions, required work, and emitted artifacts
    - worker-owned reverse processing is referenced procedurally without reassigning controller ownership
    - repetition classification is required before later surface-compression decisions
    - notation candidates, promotion candidates, and retained local unique detail remain procedurally distinct
    - downstream continuation is blocked when repetition remains unclassified
    - character reduction alone is not treated as sufficient success

```

### artifact_contract.yaml

```yaml
meta:
  artifact_name: artifact_contract.yaml
  artifact_type: governing_contract
  version: v5_c.day2_authoritative
  status: authoritative_done
  mode: exact_canon
  purpose: define artifact ontology, lifecycle, freeze mappings, handling distinctions, readiness, supersession, invalidation, quarantine, naming discipline, and artifact-event ledger obligations

governing_parent:
  controller_contract.yaml: governs controller authority and generic enforcement
  phase_contract.yaml: governs per-phase procedure and emitted artifacts

artifact_classes:
  canonical:
    - template.technical.ust
    - draft.technical.ust
    - technical.ust
  review:
    - round_robin_notes
    - contradiction_logs
    - governance_review_artifacts
  derivative_drafts:
    - draft.creative.ust
    - draft.show.summary
  frozen_derivative_surfaces:
    - creative_ust.txt
    - show_summary.txt
  packaging_outputs:
    - suno_lyrics_prompt
    - suno_style_prompt
  ledger_artifacts:
    - FOIL_promotion_ledger_entries
    - FOIL_deduplication_ledger_entries

artifact_states:
  - draft
  - frozen
  - definitively_locked
  - promotion_ready
  - generated_not_promoted
  - patch_required
  - authoritative_done
  - superseded
  - invalid
  - quarantined
  - drifted_non_authoritative

freeze_states:
  draft_freeze:
    maps_to: draft.technical.ust
  definitive_lock:
    maps_to: technical.ust
  surface_freeze:
    maps_to:
      - creative_ust.txt
      - show_summary.txt

handling_distinctions:
  notation_candidates:
    definition: repeated section blocks that may later be represented by notation after upstream classification
    not_equal_to:
      - promotion_candidates
      - retained_local_unique_detail
  promotion_candidates:
    definition: recurring material lawfully eligible for higher-level promotion under FOIL discipline
    not_equal_to:
      - notation_candidates
      - retained_local_unique_detail
  retained_local_unique_detail:
    definition: local detail that remains at local scope and may not be collapsed by deduplication or notation
    not_equal_to:
      - notation_candidates
      - promotion_candidates
  handling_rules:
    - promotion handling is distinct from notation handling
    - promotion is not repeat notation
    - retained local unique detail may not be absorbed by deduplication or notation

parent_child_relations:
  - technical.ust is parent to derivative surface drafting
  - draft.creative.ust is parent to creative_ust.txt
  - draft.show.summary is parent to show_summary.txt
  - creative_ust.txt is parent to suno_lyrics_prompt packaging
  - show_summary.txt is parent to suno_style_prompt packaging
  - review artifacts inform definitive lock but are not peer canonical artifacts

lifecycle_transitions:
  - template.technical.ust -> working technical.ust state
  - working technical.ust state -> draft.technical.ust
  - draft.technical.ust -> technical.ust
  - technical.ust -> draft.creative.ust
  - technical.ust -> draft.show.summary
  - draft.creative.ust -> creative_ust.txt
  - draft.show.summary -> show_summary.txt
  - creative_ust.txt -> suno_lyrics_prompt
  - show_summary.txt -> suno_style_prompt

readiness_rules:
  technical.ust:
    ready_only_if:
      - definitive lock applied
      - blocking contradictions resolved or explicitly carried
  creative_ust.txt:
    ready_only_if:
      - draft.creative.ust exists
      - surface freeze applied
  show_summary.txt:
    ready_only_if:
      - draft.show.summary exists
      - surface freeze applied
  promotion_readiness:
    requires:
      - FOIL-governed distinctions preserved
      - no blocking artifact-layer defect remains
  non_promotability:
    applies_if:
      - artifact shape is noncompliant
      - required upstream dependency unresolved
      - blocking contradiction remains

ledger_obligations:
  creation:
    must_record: artifact creation event
  draft_freeze:
    must_record: draft freeze event
  definitive_lock:
    must_record: definitive lock event
  promotion:
    must_record: FOIL promotion event
  deduplication:
    must_record: FOIL deduplication event
  notation_handling_annotation:
    conditional: true
    use_when: artifact governance must record a notation-handling consequence explicitly
  local_detail_retention_annotation:
    conditional: true
    use_when: artifact governance must record preserved local unique detail explicitly
  supersession:
    must_record: supersession event
  invalidation:
    must_record: invalidation event
  quarantine:
    must_record: quarantine event
  packaging_transformation:
    must_record: packaging transformation event

supersession_and_validity:
  superseded:
    use_when: a newer authoritative artifact replaces an older one without making the older artifact drifted or invalid
  invalid:
    use_when: artifact fails governing conditions and may not govern downstream work
  quarantined:
    use_when: artifact cannot be safely used until contradiction or uncertainty is resolved
  drifted_non_authoritative:
    use_when: artifact originated from a broken or non-authoritative branch and must not be used as canon

naming_rules:
  exact_identifiers_required_when_governance_depends_on_identity: true
  do_not_rename:
    - technical.ust
    - draft.technical.ust
    - creative_ust.txt
    - show_summary.txt
    - suno_lyrics_prompt
    - suno_style_prompt
  naming_drift_blocked_if: governance consequence would change under paraphrase

artifact_layer_block_conditions:
  - state_class_conflation
  - derivative_packaging_conflation
  - freeze_taxonomy_drift
  - parent_child_ambiguity
  - readiness_ambiguity
  - promotion_notation_conflation
  - collapse_of_retained_local_unique_detail
  - supersession_ambiguity
  - residual_ambiguity_requiring_downstream_reinterpretation

compliance_test:
  artifact_contract_is_compliant_only_if:
    - it remains strictly at the artifact layer
    - it preserves inherited artifact-relevant frozen canon exactly in control effect
    - it preserves the exact freeze taxonomy
    - it preserves protected exact artifact identifiers where governance consequences depend on exact naming
    - it cleanly distinguishes canonical artifacts, review artifacts, derivative draft artifacts, frozen derivative surface artifacts, packaging outputs, governed handling distinctions, artifact states, freeze states, and ledger artifacts
    - it defines enforceable lifecycle transitions and handling consequences without re-importing controller-layer or full phase-layer mechanics
    - it defines parent-child relations clearly
    - it defines naming rules and naming-drift block conditions clearly
    - it defines ledger obligations for creation, freeze, definitive lock, promotion, deduplication, conditional notation handling annotation, conditional local detail retention annotation, supersession, packaging transformation, invalidation, and quarantine
    - it defines readiness, promotability, non-promotability, supersession, invalidity, frozen status, and quarantine status clearly
    - it explicitly distinguishes promotion handling from notation handling
    - it preserves retained local unique detail against collapse-by-dedup or collapse-by-notation
    - no artifact-layer blocking defect remains

```

### artifact_taxonomy.md

```md
# artifact_taxonomy.md

## Purpose
Normalize artifact, state, freeze, handling, readiness, validity, relation, and defect vocabulary already in approved use.
This artifact stabilizes terminology only.
It does not restate full controller, phase, artifact-lifecycle, or FOIL contracts.
## Preferred Artifact-Class Vocabulary

### Canonical
- `template.technical.ust`
- `draft.technical.ust`
- `technical.ust`

### Review
- `round_robin_notes`
- `contradiction_logs`
- `governance_review_artifacts`

### Derivative Drafts
- `draft.creative.ust`
- `draft.show.summary`

### Frozen Derivative Surfaces
- `creative_ust.txt`
- `show_summary.txt`

### Packaging Outputs
- `suno_lyrics_prompt`
- `suno_style_prompt`

### Ledger Artifacts
- `FOIL_promotion_ledger_entries`
- `FOIL_deduplication_ledger_entries`

## Preferred Artifact-State Vocabulary
- `draft`
- `frozen`
- `definitively_locked`
- `promotion_ready`
- `generated_not_promoted`
- `patch_required`
- `authoritative_done`
- `superseded`
- `invalid`
- `quarantined`
- `drifted_non_authoritative`

Do not use artifact states as artifact classes.

## Preferred Freeze Vocabulary
- `draft_freeze` → `draft.technical.ust`
- `definitive_lock` → `technical.ust`
- `surface_freeze` → `creative_ust.txt` + `show_summary.txt`

Do not collapse freeze terms into one another.

## Preferred Handling Vocabulary
- `reverse processing` = upstream reverse-compilation / promotion-aware restructuring performed under lawful governance.
- `semantic compression` = lossful downstream reduction for surface efficiency; not controller-owned.
- `repetition classification` = upstream disposition of repeated material before later surface-compression decisions.
- `notation candidate` = repeated section block that may later be emitted by exact-repeat notation after upstream classification.
- `promotion candidate` = recurring material eligible for higher-level promotion under FOIL discipline.
- `retained local unique detail` = local detail that must remain local and may not be absorbed by promotion or notation.

### Required Distinctions
- notation candidates are not promotion candidates
- promotion is not repeat notation
- retained local unique detail is neither notation candidate nor promotion candidate
- FOIL governs promotion and deduplication only
- FOIL is not repeat notation
- FOIL is not the whole of reverse processing

## Preferred Relation Vocabulary
- `governing_parent`
- `child_dependent_artifact`
- `derives_from`
- `freezes_to`
- `packages_to`
- `supersedes`
- `invalidates`
- `quarantines`
## Preferred Readiness / Validity Vocabulary

### Readiness
- `promotion_ready`
- `not_ready`
- `blocked_pending_revision`

### Validity
- `authoritative`
- `superseded`
- `invalid`
- `quarantined`
- `drifted_non_authoritative`

## Defect Vocabulary
Use exact defect terms when they apply:
- `scope_drift`
- `state_class_conflation`
- `freeze_taxonomy_drift`
- `artifact_ontology_confusion`
- `promotion_notation_conflation`
- `collapse_of_retained_local_unique_detail`
- `controller_recentralization`
- `semantic_collapse_disguised_as_deduplication`
- `destructive_deduplication`
- `owner_selection_overreach`
- `naming_drift`
- `residual_ambiguity_requiring_downstream_reinterpretation`

## Crosswalk Rules
- Use `Creative UST` for the derivative shell concept; use `creative_ust.txt` for the frozen derivative surface artifact.
- Use `Show Summary` for the derivative style-surface concept; use `show_summary.txt` for the frozen derivative surface artifact.
- Use `promotion` only for FOIL-governed promotion behavior.
- Use `notation` only for lawful exact-repeat notation after upstream classification.
- Do not use `repeat` as a shortcut for both notation and promotion.
- Do not silently turn handling terms into new artifact classes.

## Minimal Sufficiency Rule
Prefer the minimum sufficient vocabulary needed to stabilize meaning and prevent drift.
Do not inflate taxonomy into contract logic or procedural ownership.


```

### foil_promotion_contract.yaml

```yaml
meta:
  artifact_name: foil_promotion_contract.yaml
  artifact_type: governing_contract
  version: v5_c.day2_authoritative
  status: authoritative_done
  mode: exact_canon
  purpose: define the exact operational contract for FOIL-controlled promotion and deduplication behavior only

governing_parent:
  controller_contract.yaml: preserves controller boundary and prohibits controller semantic compression
  phase_contract.yaml: preserves procedural distinction among notation candidates, promotion candidates, and retained local unique detail
  artifact_contract.yaml: governs artifact-layer handling distinctions and conditional annotations
  artifact_taxonomy.md: stabilizes FOIL-relevant vocabulary

artifact_role:
  in_scope:
    - formal FOIL definition
    - promotion eligibility rules
    - deduplication eligibility rules
    - canonical owner selection rules
    - semantic preservation rules
    - FOIL-specific ledger requirements
    - FOIL-specific defect categories
    - FOIL-specific block conditions
  out_of_scope:
    - repeat notation
    - full reverse-processing ownership
    - full controller authority restatement
    - full phase-machine restatement
    - full artifact ontology restatement
    - shell design
    - downstream routing heuristics

inherited_canon:
  - FOIL governs promotion and deduplication only.
  - FOIL is not repeat notation.
  - FOIL is not the whole of reverse processing.
  - Retained local unique detail must be preserved.
  - Controller may not re-centralize semantic judgment.

foil_definition:
  purpose: govern lawful promotion and deduplication of recurring material without semantic collapse
  constrained_to:
    - promotion
    - deduplication
  excludes:
    - repetition classification
    - exact-repeat notation emission
    - creative authorship

promotion_eligibility:
  allowed_only_if:
    - candidate has lawful recurring significance
    - promotion preserves meaning rather than flattening meaning
    - promotion does not erase retained local unique detail
    - upstream classification supports promotion
    - promotion event can be ledgered
  blocked_if:
    - promotion candidate is actually only a notation candidate
    - promotion would genericize section-local uniqueness
    - promotion would merge distinct semantics for convenience

deduplication_eligibility:
  allowed_only_if:
    - duplicate material is truly duplicative in semantic function
    - deduplication does not erase meaningful local variance
    - deduplication event can be ledgered
  blocked_if:
    - deduplication would collapse retained local unique detail
    - deduplication is being used as hidden compression
    - deduplication substitutes for notation handling

canonical_owner_selection:
  owner_must_be:
    - the highest lawful level that preserves meaning without erasing distinct semantics
  blocked_if:
    - owner selection is made for convenience only
    - owner selection hides unresolved classification work
    - owner selection erases local unique detail

semantic_preservation:
  required:
    - preserve distinctions among notation candidates, promotion candidates, and retained local unique detail
    - preserve distinct semantics across repeated material
    - preserve worker-owned reverse processing by reference
  forbidden:
    - absorb repeat notation into FOIL
    - redefine reverse processing as controller-owned
    - reintroduce blanket notation or local-detail annotation requirements
    - destructive deduplication
    - convenience merges

ledger_requirements:
  must_record:
    - FOIL promotion events
    - FOIL deduplication events
    - chosen canonical owner when promotion occurs
    - preserved local unique detail when FOIL action would otherwise threaten collapse
  must_not_require:
    - blanket notation-handling ledger entries
    - blanket local-detail-retention ledger entries outside conditional artifact-governance need

foil_defect_taxonomy:

    - FOIL is treated as the whole of reverse processing
    - retained local unique detail would be lost
    - a FOIL action would be unledgered
    - downstream routing heuristics are promoted into canon
    - nonexistent or drifted artifacts are referenced

compliance_test:

    - it explicitly states that promotion is not repeat notation
    - it explicitly states that FOIL is not the whole of reverse processing

    - it avoids reintroducing blanket annotation requirements

    - no FOIL-layer blocking defect remains
```

```md
# creative_ust_canonical_shell.md

## Identity
Creative UST is the downstream shell derived from definitive `technical.ust`.
It is not canonical middleware, not a controller contract, not a phase contract, not an artifact contract, and not a FOIL contract.
It preserves downstream-usable creative structure and maximal useful nuance per available character.

## Mandatory Containers
- `[Theory]`
- `[Voices]`
- `[Style]`
- `[Timbre]`
- `[Performance]`
- `[Post-Production]`
- `▸ LYRICS BLOCK`

## Mandatory Field Set

- `[mode | content]`
- `[tonal center | content]`
- `[meter | content]`
- `[tempo | content]`
- `[chord color | content]`

- `[cleanup rules | content]`

## Mandatory Syntax
Field form:
- `[field name | content]`

Section-header form:
- `[Section Title | X bars | performance notes | production cues]`
- Use `X bars`, never `(X) bars`.
- Bar counts displayed here are computed upstream, not decorative copy.
- Section header is on its own line.
- First lyric row is on the next line.

Composite lyric-row form:
- `"lyrics line", (adlib) ** sfx: optional cue **`
- Lyric, adlib, and sfx stay bound to the same row.
- Blank lines occur between composite lyric rows only.
- Lyrics rows are rendered as vocalist-sheet breath-lines in output form.

## Legacy Removals
- Crew tags are removed.
- Separate roadmap block is removed.
- Outer scaffold is forbidden.
- Wrapper commentary is forbidden.
- Acceptance/protocol text is forbidden.
- Nested fenced artifact blocks are forbidden.
- Contract-like overgrowth is forbidden.

## Handling Rules
- notation candidates are not promotion candidates.
- promotion is not repeat notation.
- retained local unique detail remains local.
- recurring performer identity belongs in `[Voices]`.
- execution order belongs in `[Performance]`.
- section-specific performance and production cues belong in section headers.
- recurring global traits may be lifted into higher shell containers only after lawful upstream promotion.
- exact repeated section blocks may be referenced only after upstream classification.
- repeat notation is lawful only for exact repeated section blocks.
- if any local detail differs, that material must be written explicitly.
- repeat notation may not absorb retained local unique detail.

## Character-Efficiency Rules
- Preserve maximal nuance per available character.
- Character reduction alone is not sufficient success.
- Do not genericize section headers for convenience.
- Do not strip useful performance or production detail that remains lawfully local.
```
